title: Across the Universe
feel: Even, gently pulsing strum, about 75 bpm (estimate)

alt_voicings.label: Options
alt_voicings.note: Dmaj7 in the verses; Gm/D as the easy Gm

sections.name: Verse
sections.bars: D | Bm | F#m | % | Em7 | % | A | A7

sections.name: Verse′
sections.note: Seven bars: V is replaced by the borrowed iv (Gm).

why: Three minor colours in a row (Bm, F♯m, Em7) and the **iv minor** (Gm in D) as an E-shape barre.
hard_change: **Em7 → Gm barre**. Keep the G on the top string as the common tone; land the barre on beat 1.
theory: I–vi–iii–ii–V; Verse′ swaps V for the borrowed iv (Gm), a B♮/B♭ cross-relation. The refrain is V–IV–I.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: Em7 → Gm, then Bm → F♯m.
With the record: tune down a half step for the *Let It Be* version (it sounds in D♭).
tips: The outro is the mantra over a D drone, fading.
